inspection: Qt widget captures inspected at 100% and 200%; no screen-state or layout corruption observed.
defaultDevices: Synthetic transports, local TCP/UDP loopback and local console fixtures; no serial hardware or external peer commands.
processing: Whole binary and empty packets, port metadata, nested single-thread Lineflow, owner responsiveness under heavy work, async timers, bounded ingress/egress, cancellation, owner-thread factory retirement, complete native TLS teardown, immediate shutdown, owned configuration.
transport: Worker construction/calls/destruction, async open/failure, partial and atomic writes, empty datagrams, cancellation epochs and native credits, queue limits, stale generations, borrowed payload/error ownership, affinity rejection, native TLS teardown.
limitations: Host symlink creation unavailable in confinement test cases.
Independent SDK consumer and additional opt-in capture cases are not enabled in the default suite.
Native pointer gestures are tested at 100%; 200% verification uses widget captures and programmatic transfers.
Timing includes Qt paint delivery, not compositor latency; host load is uncontrolled.
